dedupe_keys.name: open platform for energy networks open

description: OPEN is the University of Oxford Energy and Power Group's Python toolset for modelling smart local energy systems. It combines distributed resources, electricity markets, power-flow simulation and multi-period optimisation of flexible operation. Users configure photovoltaic generation, batteries or electric vehicles and supply local-network and demand assumptions; outputs are simulated network operation and resource schedules. Spatial coverage is a configured local system, while temporal coverage follows its input profiles and optimisation horizon. Apache-2.0 source is free and includes example starting points for electric-vehicle and building studies. A limitation is that installation instructions use Python 3.6 and historical dependency channels, so present-day environment compatibility remains untested. The toolset supports local-energy infrastructure simulations and complements PyPSA (model-pypsa). The README cites the authors' 2019 working paper. The presence of named case-study scripts was confirmed, but their empirical datasets and results were not independently assessed here.
